'''R2-A6''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] under the service of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It was on board [[Bravo Leader/Legends|Bravo 1]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]] continued to use it because of his superstition that R2-A6 was a good-luck charm.
